title: Save Your Money
text: MEH. This is nothing special and way overpriced for what one gets. My 10 yo son got the Science subscription as a birthday/ Christmas gift from family friends. It is most underwhelming, and is packaged in an unappealing way. It is more appropriate for a 6 yo than a 10 yo. Plus, Passports’ set up would not allow me to cancel or change the selection without contacting the gift giver which was going to be very awkward. So we get a bag (not box) a month that is not opened, and my friend wasted about $300. Lose, lose. This is not one of the best STEM subscriptions out there.
label: negative
